svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 TimescaleDB telemetry: install, history/latest batches, chunk routing and TTL

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 TimescaleDB telemetry: install, history/latest batches, chunk routing and TTL
Dictionary and latest remain ordinary PostgreSQL tables.
History and latest use different queues, connections and transactions.
allAsList is not a database transaction and does not roll back partial commits.
No add_retention_policy or drop_chunks in release-3.6 schema.
Row DELETE creates dead tuples and latest rows are not removed.
There is no DAO enqueue backpressure; monitor queueSize and heap.
